title: Tender German Meat Mincemeat Casserole
description: A hearty German-inspired casserole with tender meat and rich flavors. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Browning the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until fully cooked.
Add the onion, garlic, allspice, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the mushroom gravy and bring to a simmer.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a splash of water.
Add the bread to the bowl and toss until the bread is evenly coated with the egg mixture.
Add the cooked ground beef mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the casserole is golden brown and set.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
